concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 3 - Visualize Autocorrelation Heatmaps and Confidence Bands
concerns.text: User Story 3 has functional requirements (FR‑005) but no associated success criteria; the SC list only references US‑1 and US‑2. Add at least one SC (e.g., SC‑006) that measures the correctness, completeness, or performance of the heat‑map visualisation.
